Title: Paying for other people (Sunset Strip, Zelios, Ravnos Cache question)?

Messages.Author: chr...@comcen.com.au
Messages.Body:
Can you use Sunset Strip, Zelios and/or Ravnos Cache to pay for cards
played by other Meths? I think yes because they don't have specific
card text limiting them to the controlling Meth as Tshwane and Jack do
("you play"). Although Ravnos Cache seems to imply that it would need
to be used by the controlling Meth.

Sunset Strip
Tap to reduce the cost to recruit a mortal ally or employ a mortal
retainer by 1 blood or pool

Zelios
If Zelios is ready, you may tap him to pay the pool cost of a location
with his blood instead

Ravnos Cache
When equipping a minion, you may tap this card to use the blood
counters on it to pay some or all of the pool or blood cost of the
equipment

Powerbase Tshwane
Tap this location to reduce the cost of a card "you play" by 1 pool

Jack
You may tap Jack when "you play" a Master: location (unique or not) to
reduce the cost of that location by 1 pool

Chris.
